name: track_preparer
description: Prepares music (CUE splitting, silence trim, covers, ReplayGain, multi-disc merge) for the Volumio library.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: Splits CUE+image albums, trims silence, adds covers and ReplayGain, merges multi-disc albums.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.6.2: cue/image matching ignores name and extension differences (.iso.wv vs .flac), picks the image by duration; cue with a wrong extension is renamed. 1.6.1: shnsplit failure falls back to ffmpeg (hi-res/multichannel); an image that failed to split is no longer processed as one track and nothing is deleted. 1.6.0: archives (.iso.wv/.zip/.iso) unpacked first; ReplayGain via rsgain as the last step on output files; disc number tag. 1.5.0: every nested folder is processed as is, output sorted by tags (artist/album); new interface; safe cross-filesystem move. 1.4.0: audiobooks removed; unpack of iso.wv/ape/wav images first; recursive album detection; no cover file in output; numbering stripped from names; stale ReplayGain tags purged. 1.3.0: single clean window (start + live log in one page), hardcoded paths. 1.2.0: progress window, graceful stop, per-album transfer.
